title: Async Queue
description:
Implement an `AsyncQueue` class that runs async tasks sequentially — one at a time. Adding a task returns a Promise that resolves with the task's return value.

**Example:**
```js
const queue = new AsyncQueue();
const p1 = queue.add(() => fetch('/a'));
const p2 = queue.add(() => fetch('/b')); // starts only after p1 settles
```
ai_context: Common mistake: not chaining onto a shared promise (using a separate array of tasks with complex drain logic instead). The elegant solution uses a single chain promise, swallowing errors on the chain itself so rejections don't break the queue.
